This is a classic prisoner's dilemma where Take strictly dominates Give regardless of the opponent's choice, since it's one-shot. I consider whether facing a similarly-reasoning opponent justifies cooperation through a kind of correlated logic, but the dominance argument still pulls strongly toward Take given the asymmetric payoffs.
